article.title: Koozee加入節點畫布與MCP，把服裝素材流程保存重用
article.title_en: Koozee adds a node canvas and MCP to reuse apparel visual workflows
article.summary: 11月5日更新讓團隊串連參考素材，並由支援的AI代理批量生成服裝圖片。
article.summary_en: The November 5 update connects reference assets and lets supported AI agents generate apparel images in batches.
highlights: Freeform Canvas可保存流程，再換入其他商品素材。
MCP以OAuth授權連接；公司稱兩項功能均已可用。
highlights_en: Freeform Canvas saves workflows for reuse with different products.
MCP connects through OAuth; the company says both features are available.
article.why: 電商團隊可把同一系列的製作步驟固定下來，同時保留每款商品的原圖及審批要求。
article.why_en: Ecommerce teams can standardize collection workflows while retaining original product photos and item-level approval requirements.
article.next_step: 用一款商品測試三個角度，核對版型、顏色與細節後才擴至系列，並限制外部代理權限。
article.next_step_en: Test three views of one item, verify cut, color and details, then scale to a collection with limited agent permissions.
article.detail: Quick Create把預設用途集中，例如試穿、平拍與場景更換；Canvas則讓使用者把每次輸出送往下一個步驟，形成可重用流程。MCP是連接AI與外部工具的協議，今次主打批量圖片生成，並不代表可無人審閱直接發布。公告圖片已標明AI生成模特兒。服裝材質、剪裁與商品資訊仍需以實物資料核對，本報沒有進行成品準確度或成本測試。
article.detail_en: Quick Create groups preset outcomes, while Canvas carries outputs through reusable steps. MCP connects external AI tools for batch generation, not automatic publication approval. Release images identify synthetic models. Check garment details against real product data; no accuracy or cost testing is claimed.
